test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the Rajya Sabha is correct?

options.text: One-third of the members retire every year.
One-third of the members retire every second year.
Half of the members retire every year.
One-fifth of the members retire every second year.

solution:
The correct answer is **'One-third of the members retire every second year'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Rajya Sabha: **

 
 
• It is also known as the **Upper House of Parliament**.
 
• **Ex-officio Chairman:** The Vice President of India
 
• Rajya Sabha is not subjected to dissolution. Therefore One-third of the members retire every second year.
 
 
 
• **Composition:**
 
 
• The maximum strength is 250, out of which: 238 members are representatives of the states & UTs (elected indirectly). 
 
• 12 are nominated by the President. 
 
 
 
• **Election Representatives:** 
 
 
• The representatives of states are elected by the members of state legislative assemblies.
